## Batch 14 complete

All 12 assigned items have hash-bound Step 1 `ready` records with their direct dependencies. The run-wide check remains open outside this batch: it reports 37 of 59 items ready. The A/B page summaries already matched the assigned inventory and were left intact.

Repairs include an explicit dimension condition for vector sub-Gaussian variables, a sphere-net proof that establishes positive ball volume and uses radius \(\epsilon/2\), corrected proof-step inputs and canonical step numbering, and a contradiction strategy for the heavy-tail counterexample.

Checks passed: 11 proofs passed precheck; proof layout reported 12 items, 48 steps, 0 defects; strict contracts passed 12/12; boundary audit found no template or contradicted dispositions; dependency levels matched the manifest; and depcheck, content-policy, and rendercheck passed. Source fetch verified all 5 coverage rows. The coverage checklist had no errors, with two low-yield warnings awaiting Alpha review. No registered finite-smoke checks applied.

The A-page source coverage records full-text reading of [Rigollet–Hütter](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.19244v1), [Duchi](https://web.stanford.edu/class/stats311/lecture-notes.pdf), and [Wellner](https://faculty.washington.edu/jonw/RESEARCH/TALKS/Delft/emp-proc-delft-big.pdf).
